label: D1 after an unrewarded common a1->S1 trial (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (none at GO or D2). The strongest activations, near the max, come at the D1 right after a trial where the agent chose a1, made the common transition to S1 and got no reward, usually after a run of rewarded a1->S1 trials (the cue to switch away from a1). Every active step with prev a1 and no reward had a common previous transition. Much weaker activations (about 0.2-0.3 of the max) show up at D1 during runs of rewarded a1->S1 trials, which is where most misses come from. It is strongly tied to episode time: most activity is in trials 10-60 and it is silent after about trial 70, so a lot of false positives are late-episode trials that otherwise fit. It sits in a narrow band of model value (7.1-7.7). Recorded predicate uses only observed variables, scored F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.73 on dev; without the ep_trial cut F1 is 0.39 at the same mass recall. a2/S2 history gives almost no activity (the unit is asymmetric toward a1/S1).
